input.quote: This Terminal Station Right of Use shall commence on the RFS Date and shall continue for the duration of this Agreement.
input.rationale:
The licence analogue is the Terminal Station Right of Use in §11 (with the capacity/IRU rights in §12). It runs for the full duration of the Agreement (§11.1), carries no charges beyond Capital Costs and O&M (§11.2), extends to our IRU purchasers (§11.5), and is not revocable at the Terminal Parties' discretion — the only forfeiture route is reclamation of capacity under §23 for unpaid amounts after notice and a two-month cure period, i.e. uncured material breach. On transfer/scope, §22.3-22.4 allow assignment to a successor, Parent Company, Subsidiary or Affiliate without Management Committee consent, subject only to written notice under §22.6; other transfers need consent not to be unreasonably withheld, and §12.20/§12.22 permit unrestricted IRU sales and commercial use by other Carriers after the stated trigger. This meets the fallback (affiliates on written notice; successor transfer) and largely reaches the preferred position. Noted but not redlined: contractors acting on our behalf are not expressly named (though §17.3 contemplates shared/co-located Direct Access facilities), and the right is for the life of the Agreement rather than expressed as perpetual and irrevocable, which is standard for a consortium cable system.</rationale>
